description: Country lookup: find a country or territory by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3 or numeric code, or by name, and get the other codes, the official and common English names, the UN M49 region and sub-region, the currencies in use, the country-code TLD, and optionally the full ISO 3166-2 subdivision list with each subdivision's type. Also resolves an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code such as NL-NH directly. Names are matched case- and accent-insensitively. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3 or numeric code, or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code such as NL-NH. Accepted: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3/numeric, or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code.

include.description: Comma-separated: subdivisions, m49, currency, tld. Default m49,currency,tld. Accepted: comma-separated subset of subdivisions, m49, currency, tld.

name.description: Substring search on country names, case- and accent-insensitive. Accepted: at most 128 characters.

name: country_lookup
title: Country lookup: ISO 3166 codes, currency, TLD, UN region and ISO 3166-2 subdivisions
